title: Pentaryn Senses
description: Lights, glow and chains for dnd5e 6. Token vision from the sheet's senses is dnd5e's own now (senseVisionSync); this module only resets, once per world, the darkvision sight its retired 0.3 sync stored on tokens, so a removed sense really goes dark (setting pentaryn-senses.sightReset, active GM, on ready). Lights carried by items (flags.pentaryn-senses.light) light whoever carries them and go dark when the item leaves. Torches, lamps, lanterns and candles get a Light/Douse button on the inventory row (flags.pentaryn-senses.lit), hooded lanterns a hood. The Light cantrip lights a token or a square instead of summoning a floor token ("On me" / "Pick a target" on cast, and On me / Pick a target / End as icons in the spell card's action row). Adds the "Broken glow (wandering)" light animation (pentaryn-brokenglow), whose size and brightness ride a wave that never repeats, and token chains drawn between two tokens. Writes run on the active GM's client only. Exposes game.pentaryn.senses.
